# modal-dsh

> DeepSeek Harness plugin for Modal cloud sandboxes. Seven `modal_sandbox_*` tools over a long-lived child process that hosts the Modal JavaScript SDK.

## Key facts

- Tools: create, exec, exec_wait, output, info, terminate, set_credentials
- Architecture: plugin (host process) ⇄ NDJSON over stdio ⇄ `bridge.mjs` (owns the Modal SDK and the sandbox registry)
- The bridge ships inside the package (`lib/bridge.mjs`), is written into `<workspaceRoot>/modal-dsh`, and gets the SDK via a one-time `npm install`
- Credential order: `MODAL_TOKEN_ID`/`MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET` env → DSH credential named `modal` → `credentials.json`
- Runtime guard: `assertPeerCompatible()` rejects silently-linked older `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` copies
- Sandboxes survive a bridge restart — they re-attach by ID via `client.sandboxes.fromId`

## Key files

- src/index.ts — plugin entry: name, inject, Config, apply, peer guard
- src/bridge-host.ts — child-process supervisor, bootstrap, credentials, NDJSON protocol
- src/tools.ts — the seven tool definitions
- src/bridge.mjs — the Modal SDK host process (shipped verbatim)
- scripts/integration-test.mjs — packed-artifact install + real tool invocation

## Upstream

- Modal JS SDK: https://modal.com
- DSH plugin template: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-template
